# llm

```go
import "github.com/blanketops/environments-bots/internal/llm"
```

Package llm is a small client for any OpenAI\-compatible chat completions API \(OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Together, a local server, or an Anthropic shim\). Bots use it for optional, advisory model passes; it is never on a blocking path, and when no API key is configured there is no client at all and the caller falls back to its deterministic behaviour.

<a name="Client"></a>
## type Client

Client completes a chat prompt and returns the assistant's text.

```go
type Client interface {
    Complete(ctx context.Context, system, user string) (string, error)
}
```

<a name="FromEnv"></a>
### func FromEnv

```go
func FromEnv(getenv func(string) string) Client
```

FromEnv builds a client from LLM\_API\_KEY, LLM\_BASE\_URL and LLM\_MODEL, or returns nil when LLM\_API\_KEY is unset — the caller then stays deterministic. Defaults: OpenRouter, Claude Sonnet \(strong code review per dollar\). The return type is the Client interface so a no\-key result is a true nil.

<a name="OpenAICompat"></a>
## type OpenAICompat

OpenAICompat talks to an OpenAI\-compatible /chat/completions endpoint.

```go
type OpenAICompat struct {
    BaseURL string // e.g. https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
    APIKey  string
    Model   string
    HTTP    *http.Client
}
```
